sql: select strategy, count(*) filter (where status = $$open$$) as open_now, count(*) filter (where created_at > now() - interval $$7 days$$) as opened_7d, count(*) filter (where status <> $$open$$ and created_at > now() - interval $$30 days$$) as closed_30d, count(*) as total_rows, min(created_at)::date as first_trade, max(created_at)::date as last_trade from paper_trades where strategy ilike $$%mmsell%$$ group by strategy order by opened_7d desc, open_now desc
